Name: Better Meadowlands Farm
Author: colourpencilsgirl
Description:
This farm type does not replace any existing farms. It is identical to the vanilla Meadowlands Farm, except for a small pond close to the main farming area just outside the farmhouse (see images for more detail). It does not change the farm type on existing farms, and it will still be possible to choose the vanilla Meadowlands Farm in new games. The in-game description of the farm is "There is a small pond close to the main farming area outside the farmhouse. It has a chewy blue grass that animals love. You start with two chickens." 

Note for multiplayer:
If you choose more than one cabin in "Nearby" mode, one of them will spawn on top of the pond and be inaccessible. Here are a few ways you can fix this (non-exhaustive list):
1. Go to Robin and she can move the cabin for free, instantly (probably best option).
2. Choose "Separate" instead of "Nearby" mode (will make cabins further apart).
3. Build the cabins at Robin's instead of at farm creation (this will cost 100 g per cabin).

Link to the github repository for this mod: https://github.com/youessbee/bettermeadowlands?tab=readme-ov-file
